rules.measurement_or_actuator_fault: Any invalid frequency source, reference authority, estimator support, identity, transaction, acknowledgement, applied-code association or non-finite response; also a third consecutive indeterminate response after cumulative expected movement is at least two empirical detection floors. Plant-model applicability and SHT41 context are evaluated separately and cannot erase an otherwise valid observed response.
rules.inside_deadband: Absolute post-response frequency error is no greater than the frozen error deadband.
rules.limit_reached: The current code is at a hard range endpoint and the I-only correction sign would request movement beyond it.
rules.wrong_sign: The observed frequency change is opposite the positive plant-gain direction by at least the empirical detection floor.
rules.growing_error: Absolute error increased by more than the frozen deadband margin after a commanded step.
rules.excess_response: Absolute observed change exceeds abs(delta)*gain_max plus the additive empirical floor+hysteresis+repeatability margin.
rules.healthy_detected: Observed change has the commanded sign, is at least the empirical detection floor, and is no greater than the excess-response threshold.
rules.healthy_indeterminate_near_resolution: All evidence is healthy but the observed and cumulative signed response remain below the empirical detection floor; at most two consecutive steps may continue.
rules.cumulative_evidence: Cumulative response is measured from the pre-series baseline and compared with the sign of cumulative applied code movement; it never substitutes for a healthy current transaction.
rules.diagnostic_trajectory: The 60 s trajectory may corroborate onset/sign only and is never command-authoritative.
rules.measurement_control_separation: Classify every response from measurement-valid evidence first. If the measurement is valid but the plant model is inapplicable, preserve the numerical response and enter OUT_OF_MODEL_HOLD with no new actionable request.
rules.temperature_context: Finite SHT41 nearby-air observations are retained as a covariate. Missing, stale or outside-observed-context temperature is not measurement_or_actuator_fault and is not a control veto for this non-temperature-dependent plant model.
